{{Quote|Perhaps. I've located a long, enclosed valley that I believe will be deep enough to hold us.''"<br />"''I don't see how that gains us anything. Enclosed valleys imply valley walls, which imply a sudden stop somewhere along the line.''"<br />"''In this case, the stop would be somewhat less violent. This particular valley is full of small rocks.''"<br />"''I wonder how ''that'' happened.''"<br />"''Multiple asteroid or meteor collisions, most likely. It doesn't matter. An enclosed '''valley''' filled with small [[Stone/Legends|stones]] was the site where [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lorana Jinzler]] crashed the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="OBF" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
